summary: Batch focused web/UI checks with a shared rooted dev shell and cross-worktree incremental TypeScript seeds.

schema.detail: No persistent application schema changes; compiler state is disposable.

rules.detail: Focused checks retain check-lane admission; warm preparation happens before admission, cold shell realization happens inside admission, and full suites are not accepted.

compatibility.detail: Existing package scripts and CI workflows remain unchanged. Buck client targets are not used as evidence for app/UI checks.

manual.detail: Use python3 scripts/web-check check followed by selected app test paths. Warm preparation reuses the shared profile and installs frozen dependencies before taking a check slot; cold shells are realized inside the slot.

recovery.detail: Delete .devenv/web-check to discard incremental state. Remove the affected shared fractal-web-check/v1 shell cache entry and run check FILE... again to reconstruct its profile under admission.
